en.title: Verba — Voice Translator
en.subtitle: Translate, talk & learn
en.short_description: Translate speech live, practise conversation, and learn words that stick.
en.description:
Verba is a translator you can talk to, and a way to keep what you learn from the conversation.

—— Translate ——

LIVE TRANSLATE
Follow a real conversation as it happens, with speech recognised and translated as people speak.

TRANSLATE
Type or speak a phrase and get it back in the language you need.

TALK
A voice-first mode for when typing is not practical.

—— Learn ——

PRACTICE
Conversational practice, so the language gets used rather than just read.

FLASHCARDS
Spaced repetition brings a word back just before you would have forgotten it, rather than drilling what you already know.

PHRASEBOOK
The phrases you actually need, kept together.

CHAT
A conversational partner to practise against.

—— Built to be used ——

• Natural text-to-speech, so you hear how it should sound
• Material 3 interface with glassmorphic cards
• Notification reminders for your streak and practice, using inexact alarms
• No account needed to start

—— Ads and Premium ——

Verba is free and shows ads through Google AdMob. On iOS you will be asked whether the app may use your device's advertising identifier; you can decline and still use everything. An optional Premium upgrade removes ads.

—— About translation quality ——

Translation and speech recognition are automated and imperfect, especially with accents, background noise, idiom and specialist vocabulary. Do not rely on Verba for medical, legal, financial, safety or immigration matters — use a qualified human interpreter.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
Verba is a translator you can talk to, and a way to keep what you learn from the conversation.

Intended audience:
Translate, talk & learn

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Firebase (Google) — app initialisation
- Firebase Crashlytics (Google) — crash reporting
- Firebase Analytics (Google) — usage analytics
- Google AdMob — advertising
- Apple In-App Purchase — paid features

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (locale 1, locale 10, locale 11, locale 12, locale 2, locale 3, locale 4, locale 5, locale 6, locale 7, locale 8, locale 9). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
